assertionResults.fullName: computeLeafDrawOrder (T2, leaf-draw-order) T5: a ROOT-level empty package sorts as a GROUP sibling of the root namespaces, by shared creation counter -- NOT among the unpackaged leaves (D2). jar-verified 2026-08-15 via oracle-render.sh on `class X / package E {} / package P { class A } / class Y`: draw order is `E, P.A, X, Y` (E created before P, so E prints before P's own leaf A; X/Y are truly unpackaged and print only after the whole root-group pass finishes).
assertionResults.title: T5: a ROOT-level empty package sorts as a GROUP sibling of the root namespaces, by shared creation counter -- NOT among the unpackaged leaves (D2). jar-verified 2026-08-15 via oracle-render.sh on `class X / package E {} / package P { class A } / class Y`: draw order is `E, P.A, X, Y` (E created before P, so E prints before P's own leaf A; X/Y are truly unpackaged and print only after the whole root-group pass finishes).

assertionResults.fullName: computeLeafDrawOrder (T2, leaf-draw-order) T5: a NESTED empty package sorts as a child-group sibling of its parent's other child namespaces, AFTER the parent's own real leaves (`printGroup`: leaves in full, then subgroups -- never merged by rank). jar-verified 2026-08-15 via oracle-render.sh on `package P { class A / package Inner {} / class B } class Z`: draw order is `P.A, P.B, P.Inner, Z` -- Inner (created between A and B) still draws AFTER B, since it is a child GROUP of P, not one of P's own leaves.
assertionResults.title: T5: a NESTED empty package sorts as a child-group sibling of its parent's other child namespaces, AFTER the parent's own real leaves (`printGroup`: leaves in full, then subgroups -- never merged by rank). jar-verified 2026-08-15 via oracle-render.sh on `package P { class A / package Inner {} / class B } class Z`: draw order is `P.A, P.B, P.Inner, Z` -- Inner (created between A and B) still draws AFTER B, since it is a child GROUP of P, not one of P's own leaves.
